cover.title: Freakonomics
cover.author: Steven D. Levitt & Stephen J. Dubner

segments.text: What does a Chicago schoolteacher have in common with a four-hundred-pound sumo wrestler? Both cheat. And the numbers caught them.
When a teacher's pay depends on test scores, some quietly fix the answers after class. Levitt caught them: a whole class acing the hardest questions with identical answers.
Sumo's the same. On the final day, a wrestler who desperately needs a win gets it, then loses the rematch. The favor repaid.
People cheat when the payoff is huge and the odds of getting caught feel tiny. Not evil. Just incentives.
